endpoint: sign(delta_pred)==sign(delta_true), abs(delta_true)>0.01 rad/s; abs(delta_pred)<=0.01 counts incorrect
interval: sign(dt-weighted mean delta_pred)==sign(dt-weighted mean delta_true); abs(mean delta_true)>historical per-axis frozen floor; no prediction amplitude gate (original definition)
origin: original GRU causal measured gyro at decision, verified equal to PAHBD original anchor; no future correction
floor_scope: historical TRAIN q25 thresholds reused numerically; not recalibrated on current train or validation, not a noise estimate
aggregation: eligible windows within flight then equal eligible flights, then equal seeds; amplitude ratio = mean flight RMS predicted increment / mean flight RMS true increment
selection: 108 main_50hz windows of the original fixed validation cohort, 27 common flights; frozen H1000-GRU-Control and independently selected A/B best checkpoints; same paired sensor labels and native state rows
case: seed17, nominal2s, middle member after sorting flight_id; selected by identity not error
